name: 68355 · Falls City, NE
findings: ZIP 68355 (Falls City) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68355 (Falls City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68355 (Falls City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
